items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You mentioned that you loved Al Haig...

ctx.x: In New York at the time, $150 would be expensive for an unfurnished apartment. I’d like to speak a bit, if we can, about the development of your piano playing. We’ve spoken a lot about your devotion to bebop. You mentioned that you loved Al Haig...
